node.title: The divisor-depth induction: excess concurrency buys shared-divisor depth, one unit per dimension
node.statement: F_r for gcd-trivial r-flats by induction: at each multiplicity->=j point, either the hyperplanes through it are SPREAD (pair/r-tuple counting binds — now PROVED as f_spread_descent_dichotomy L1+L2) or RANK-DEFECT coincidence (corrected from 'twin-type': equal hyperplanes OR a common pencil/subflat) forces a shared divisor and strict descent (PROVED, L3). REMAINING CONTENT (the honest residue): the GLOBAL PACKING STEP — the spread bound carries an n^r-type numerator; the induction closes only if f_scale_recursion (or a packing argument) absorbs the r-tuple count into an absolute exponent B_F.
node.attack_surface: REGIME-CORRECTED (Brief E): the induction/packing bound is for PROPER low-dim planes dim P << j (the applied fiber-plane regime), NOT the degenerate full-space j=dim P case. Close the packing step in that regime via f_scale_recursion + the spread bound (now non-vacuous).

node.notes: The spread/rank-defect dichotomy and strict descent are proved.
